messages.text:
"Create an addictive 3D online multiplayer MMORPG game for Android.

Game name: LEGEND OF WARRIORS

Features:

- Huge open world with villages, cities, dungeons and castles.
- Real-time online multiplayer.
- Warrior, Assassin, Mage and Archer classes.
- Monster hunting, boss battles and epic quests.
- Player-versus-player battles and guild wars.
- Rare weapons, armor, pets and mounts.
- Trading system where players can trade items.
- Player marketplace and auction house.
- Daily missions, tournaments and seasonal events.
- Beautiful graphics and smooth mobile controls.
- Leveling system from level 1 to 200.
- Fair free-to-play progression without pay-to-win.
- Secure account system and cloud saves.
- Turkish language support.

Make the game exciting, competitive and rewarding. Players should be able to build their own characters, explore a massive fantasy world, fight powerful monsters and become legendary warriors.
"
